From: Emma Novak <emma@bluepeak.co>

Cc: partners@bluepeak.co
Date: Wed, 3 Jan 2028 15:22:00 -0500
Subject: Request: partner-funded trial credits for Bluepeak S23 cohort

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Bluepeak is kicking off our Spring 2028 (S23) accelerator cohort next month and we’d love to provide Redwood credits to the 12 startups accepted into the program. The ask is straightforward: 100,000 tokens per startup (usable as trial credits, single-use voucher), active for 90 days from activation.

We attached the cohort roster (accelerator_cohort_list.csv) and a brief SOW outline (see attached). Key dates: cohort kickoff Feb 6, mentor demos Feb 28. Can you confirm process for partner-sourced credits via the cloud marketplace or a voucher workflow? Also let us know any information Legal/Finance will need.

Thanks — looking forward to making this low-friction for the founders.

Emma Novak
Partnerships Director | Bluepeak Accelerator
emma@bluepeak.co

Attachments: accelerator_cohort_list.csv (csv), Bluepeak_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)

Emma —

Really excited to help — congrats on the cohort. Quick notes and next steps: 

- We can route partner-funded credits three ways: marketplace entitlement (recommended for trackability), bulk voucher codes, or a partner billing allowance applied to the partner account.
- To finalize, we need: cohort list (received), activation window, expected avg token burn per demo, and a signed credit agreement (legal).
- Ben from GTM will propose allocation mechanics; Kimberly will advise on voucher vs marketplace flow and DocuSign template.

Ben/Kimberly — looping you in to size and approve. Emma — if Finance/Legal want a draft credit agreement, we can attach our standard partner credit addendum and generate the DocuSign link.

Best,

Thanks — ran rough numbers. If we provision 100k tokens x 12 startups = 1.2M tokens. Based on the cohort’s projected demo usage and an expected redemption window of 90 days, estimated gross credit value is ~$1,200 (using our $0.001/token baseline for trial allocations).

Proposal (fast cadence option):
- Allocate 1,200,000 token voucher pool attached to Bluepeak partner account.
- Create 12 single-use voucher codes (10k each) that can be redeemed in the marketplace or via redemption link.
- Voucher expiration: 90 days from first redemption; all codes expire no later than 2028-05-15.

This keeps ledgering simple for Finance and gives founders self-serve redemption. Emma — will Bluepeak accept voucher codes or do you need direct marketplace entitlements?

If voucher route is fine, I’ll ask Finance for approval and Kimberly to prepare the DocuSign.

—Ben
